== Research ==
Baikie developed the UK's first UHV High Resolution Scanning Kelvin Probe (SKP) incorporating surface tracking which has been applied to a range of surface phenomena. His research was awarded the alpha 5 ''status,'' indicating ''"Highly significant contribution to the field“''. All EPSRC projects held by Prof. Baikie have achieved a ''minimum'' of alpha 4 for scientific/technical merit. Ambient and vacuum versions of the device have been developed. Application of the Vacuum version include in-situ profiling of high and low work function surfaces as suitable targets for hyperthermal surface ionisation, work which was funded by [[Defence Evaluation and Research Agency|DERA]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rae.ac.uk/2001/submissions/Textform.asp?route=1&HESAInst=H-0104&UoA=32&Msub=Z&Form=RA5a|title=RAE 2001 : Submissions|website=www.rae.ac.uk|access-date=2017-01-08|archive-date=9 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170109184634/http://www.rae.ac.uk/2001/submissions/Textform.asp?route=1&HESAInst=H-0104&UoA=32&Msub=Z&Form=RA5a|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Honours==
Baikie was one of the people who received a John Logie Baird Award in 2008, given in name of [[John Logie Baird]] by Logie Baird's grandson, for innovation and enterprise.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/scotland/edinburgh_and_east/7775200.stm|title=Jam boy Scotland's top innovator|work=[[BBC News]] |date=10 December 2008|access-date=31 December 2016}}</ref> In November 2015, the [[Institute of Physics]] awarded Baikie the [[Swan Medal and Prize]] for his contributions to the development of [[Kelvin probe]] method instrumentation.<ref name="IoP">{{cite web |title=Institute of Physics awards > Gold medals > The Swan medal > The Swan/Business and Innovation medal recipients |url=http://www.iop.org/about/awards/gold/swan/medallists/page_65850.html|website=www.iop.org |publisher=[[Institute of Physics]] |accessdate=29 March 2016}}</ref> Baikie was appointed [[Member of the Order of the British Empire]] (MBE) in the [[2017 New Year Honours]] for services to science education.<ref name="NY2017"/><ref>{{London Gazette|issue=61803|supp=y|page=N15|date=31 December 2016}}</ref>
